entities.summary: Robert Joseph Coyle is an American prelate of the Roman Catholic Church who has been serving as auxiliary bishop of the Diocese of Rockville Centre in New York since 2018. He previously served as an auxiliary bishop of the Archdiocese for the Military Services, USA in Washington D.C. from 2013 to 2018
